pages.alt: I go to a shop. The shop is on my left.

Use a stable rear-following viewpoint so HER LEFT is also clearly the viewer's LEFT. The right branch is an empty garden path. Show her full body from behind, both branches of the path, and fruit shop location all clearly in one natural-perspective daily-life scene. Do not reverse or mirror direction. Generous padding, minimal clutter, warm clean setting, no traffic.
